title: linear fetch_users
description: One record per Linear workspace member, including disabled members. The payload is the connector's UserNode re-encoded, so every key is always present and nothing else is.

createdAt.description: When the user was created. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

updatedAt.description: When the user last changed. Also the DataDate. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

archivedAt.description: When the entity was archived, or null.
